name: Shinobi Otoshi
source:
The Sengoku period.
Our camp, through good fortune, managed to capture Ayame,
an enemy known as the strongest of the ninjas.
The protagonist is given an order.

"Break Ayame, and make her spill her secrets...!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01052320.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
战国时期。
我们的阵营幸运地抓住了彩女，
被称为最强忍者的敌人。
主角接到命令。

“击垮绫女，让她泄露秘密……！”
